response.sql: WITH hand_tallies AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, 'Missing')), hand_shares AS (SELECT throwing_hand, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_tallies), shares_with_average AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share;
